findings.basis: True comes from the Sony Open Devices AOSP carrier config overlays. Each carrier entry there (dated 2020-07-02) carries the same block, which enables VoLTE, VoWiFi and ViLTE and sets auto_retry_failed_wifi_emergency_call true. That is 170 entries, all true. The Sony device trees in LineageOS repeat it for the DT/Orange group networks. Motorola sm7250 sets true for Play 260-98, and Qualcomm vendor.xml default blocks in 91 LineageOS device trees also set true. For the 7 profiles where the Google lane serves true (vodafone_nl, sfr_fr x2, o2postpaid_gb, gamma_gb, telekom_de, vodafone_ie), OCD's value equals the Google lane. The 12 profiles that list no family (312-120, 404-750..756, 420-02, 454-00 x4) trace in the evidence index to the same Sony source, and the Sony candidates hold true entries for those MCC-MNCs. These are real shipped values, though vendor-wide rather than set by each carrier. Some device trees disagree for a few networks (OnePlus sm8350 has false for Turkcell and Vodafone TR, Sony has false for some Orange FR MVNO IMSI ranges). That does not matter here because the branch is unreachable.
findings.effect: Domain selection is off on this ROM (empty config_domain_selection_service_component_name, config.xml:393; DomainSelectionResolver.java:139-146; the phone's dumpsys on LineageOS 24.0 shows componentName=[]). The domain selection service would not read this key at all. In the legacy path the key is loaded into mAutoRetryFailedWifiEmergencyCall (ImsPhoneCallTracker.java:1995-1996) and used in exactly one place: ImsCall.Listener.onCallTerminated, when the reason is CODE_SIP_ALTERNATE_EMERGENCY_CALL (1514) and domain selection is not supported (:3792-3816). There Telephony turns airplane mode off, waits up to 10 s for radio on and redials the last dial string on the GsmCdmaPhone (:4966-5001). With false the call just ends with DisconnectCause.IMS_SIP_ALTERNATE_EMERGENCY_CALL. Telephony maps that cause to a message (DisconnectCauseUtil.java) and does not redial: TelephonyConnectionService.maybeReselectDomain returns false without domain selection (TelephonyConnectionService.java:3076-3078). The AOSP ImsStack never reaches that branch. It creates 1514 only in StartErrorHandler::HandleNonUeDetectableEmergencyCall, a 380 answer to a normal (not UE-detected emergency) INVITE (StartErrorHandler.cpp:444-476). ImsCallSessionImpl.onCallStartFailed then clears MO_PROGRESSING (:3183-3188, OCD fork :3209-3214), so notifyCallEnd picks START_FAILED and calls callSessionInitiatingFailed (ImsCallSessionCallback.java:96-108). The framework maps that to ImsCall.onCallStartFailed (ImsCallSession.java:1296-1312, ImsCall.java:2612-2643), where the legacy path disconnects with the 1514 cause and never reads the flag (ImsPhoneCallTracker.java:3641-3685). The OCD fork's change (TERMINATED after a local hang-up) does not change this: setTerminationReason keeps the first reason, so a local hang-up reports the user's reason, not 1514 (fork :651-662, :1771-1795, :2019-2027). A UE-detected emergency call (112/911) that fails over Wi-Fi or LTE uses EmergencyStartErrorHandler. That handler returns CODE_LOCAL_CALL_CS_RETRY_REQUIRED/EXTRA_CODE_CALL_RETRY_EMERGENCY by default, not 1514 (EmergencyStartErrorHandler.cpp:102-141), so it gets the CS silent redial whatever this key says. On this ROM and stack the key is read but has no reachable effect.
findings.risk: None found on this ROM and stack. The flag is consulted only for a 1514 arriving through onCallTerminated, and the AOSP ImsStack (both the tree and the OCD fork) delivers 1514 only through onCallStartFailed. UE-detected emergency calls that fail over IMS get the CS redial either way. If a future ImsStack did deliver 1514 through callSessionTerminated, true would leave airplane mode and retry on cellular instead of failing. That favours completing the emergency call, though for a non-UE-detectable number the redial goes back out as a normal call through GsmCdmaPhone.dial. Re-read if ImsStack's start-failure reporting or the domain selection setting changes.

notes: Proceed for all 172 profiles. Domain selection is off, so only the legacy ImsPhoneCallTracker path reads the key. That path acts only on an alternate-emergency (380) reason delivered as a call termination, and the AOSP ImsStack on this ROM always delivers it as a start failure. Emergency start failures come back as CS retry and are redialed on CS anyway. Serving true instead of Android's false therefore changes no emergency call on LineageOS 24.0 with the AOSP ImsStack. Seven profiles already get true from the Google lane, and the value is a real shipped setting (Sony AOSP, LineageOS device overlays, Google).
